checks.title: Confirm payables role
checks.instructions: Confirm entity, owner, and whether this is the primary Crew role or a supporting pack. Preserve an existing identity and record payment authority separately.

checks.title: Verify the payables skill
checks.instructions: Confirm skills/spend-payables-coordinator/SKILL.md exists and spend-payables-coordinator is selected for this Crew.

checks.title: Agree on spend policy
checks.instructions: Confirm approval levels, budget owners, required PO/receipt evidence, vendor verification, duplicate criteria, and payment boundaries. Record stable decisions in MEMORY.md.

checks.title: Verify source records
checks.instructions: Identify the authoritative AP system and read a representative authorized bill/expense export for the agreed period and currency. A file is sufficient; a connector is optional. Note any missing payment-status source.

checks.title: Map vendors and bill fields
checks.instructions: Verify vendor IDs, invoice numbers, dates, amounts, currency, PO/contract references, categories, approvals, and paid/scheduled state on a sample. Keep bill, card, and receipt records separate until matched.

checks.title: Test duplicate and policy checks
checks.instructions: Check a sample for repeated vendor/invoice/amount combinations, credits, partial payments, changed bank details, and missing approvals; document false-match caveats.

checks.title: Review the first payables queue
checks.instructions: Produce a dated, source-linked queue with due dates, amount/currency, status, approver, policy reason, and evidence gaps. Complete after the owner reviews a representative result.

checks.title: Decide where the queue goes
checks.instructions: Choose Crew chat or an approved destination. Chat-only completes this decision. Verify recipient and privacy before any delivery.

checks.title: Decide on recurring review
checks.instructions: Choose chat-only, a schedule, or authenticated bill event. Chat-only completes this decision. Test source freshness and duplicate handling before enabling recurrence.
